Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class BigQueue<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigQueue<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of element stored in the queue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<T>
public class BigQueue<T> extends Object implements Iterable<T>
A custom implementation of a first-in first-out queue which can hold up to Long.MAX_VALUE elements and which uses long integers to measure its size().
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
